articles.title: Armstrong's 9th Annual Avenge Hunger Month Food Drive
articles.subtitle: Images
articles.body:
Together, We Can Avenge Hunger!

Avenge Hunger Month 2026 kicked off Monday, August 24, and runs through Sunday, October 4. Throughout these six weeks, Armstrong employees and customers from across the company’s footprint will unite to fight food insecurity by collecting food, raising funds, volunteering, and building community partnerships that help our neighbors in need.

Get Involved and Support Your Community!
Drop off donations to the Armstrong Local Office located at 1141 Lafayette Rd, Medina Monday through Friday between the hours of 9:00am-5:00pm

Learn more at www.ArmstrongFiber.com/BreakingBread

articles.title: Harvest Jamboree Fundraiser to support Hospice in Medina!
articles.subtitle: Images
articles.body: Join Reserve Care on October 3rd at 6pm at Forever Farms Blueberry Barn for a community celebration of compassionate hospice care right here in our community! The event will feature live music, a BBQ dinner, signature cocktails, and exciting raffle prizes. Funds raised from this event support hospice, palliative care, grief support, Veteran's programming and more in Medina County. Visit reserve-care.org/jamboree for more info and to purchase tickets!

articles.title: Medina Athletics Sponsorship Opportunities
articles.subtitle: Check out this great opportunity!
articles.body:
As the fall sports season begins on August 1, we invite Chamber members, local businesses, and community supporters to join us in supporting Medina Athletics and cheering on our Medina Bees.

The impact of community support is remarkable. Over the past 10 years, the Medina Athletic Boosters have raised nearly $500,000 to help support athletic programs and offset expenses that school budgets simply cannot cover. In addition, the Boosters have contributed $20,000 annually to support Medina Prom for each of the last five years, helping create memorable experiences for our students beyond athletics.

Your support has helped fund important projects and improvements across the district, including:

A new AED to enhance student and spectator safety
New baseball and softball windscreens
Brand-new scoreboards in both the gymnasium and Duke's Stadium
Full funding for Medina's new Girls Flag Football Team
Countless equipment, facility, and program enhancements that directly benefit our student-athletes

As we look toward the future, our goal is to raise even more support so that additional improvements can be made to athletic facilities and new capital projects. Every sponsorship and donation helps create opportunities to improve the student-athlete experience, and invest in facilities and equipment that will serve Medina students, families, and the community for years to come.

Become a Medina Athletic Booster Sponsor

Supporting Medina Athletics is easy and provides a great opportunity to promote your business while giving back to the community. Businesses can gain valuable exposure through:

Advertising on the new LED Board at athletic events
Business listings and advertisements on the Medina Athletics Website
Visibility within the Medina Athletics App
Sponsorship opportunities at athletic events and Booster activities

Thousands of students, parents, alumni, and community members engage with Medina Athletics throughout the year, making sponsorship an effective way to showcase your support while increasing awareness of your business.

To learn more about sponsorship opportunities, memberships, or donations, visit www.medinaboosters.org or contact the Medina Athletic Boosters.

Support the Bees This Fall

We encourage everyone to come out and support the Bees in person this fall. Whether you're filling the stands on Friday nights, attending matches and competitions, becoming a sponsor, or making a donation, your involvement makes a lasting difference.

Thank you for investing in Medina's students, student-athletes, and the future of our community. Together, we can continue building on the success of the past decade and provide even greater opportunities for future generations of Medina Bees.

Go Bees! 🐝

Ken Dworznik
VP Sponsorship
Medina Athletic Boosters
boostervpsponsor@medinabees.org
